name: extend_session_timeout
description:
Extend the maximum execution time of a running session by a duration in milliseconds (minimum 1000). The session must be active and able to accept commands, and the total timeout cannot exceed the account's maximum limit.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/extend-timeout --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

duration.description: The amount of time in milliseconds to add to the current timeout. Must be at least 1000ms (1 second).

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the session to extend the timeout for.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
